metadata.description: Agentic AI — four independently-versioned plugins: persistent memory (Cortex), codebase intelligence (automatised-pipeline), genius reasoning (zetetic-team-subagents), and PRD generation (prd-spec-generator).

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code. Thermodynamic heat/decay model, intent-aware retrieval, biological plasticity, codebase intelligence integration. 47 MCP tools. PostgreSQL + pgvector in CLI mode; automatic SQLite fallback in sandboxed/Cowork mode. 41 published papers as sources.
plugins.runtime_notes: CLI mode requires PostgreSQL 15+ with pgvector extension. Cowork/sandboxed mode falls back to SQLite automatically (set CORTEX_RUNTIME=cowork or leave DATABASE_URL unset).

plugins.name: codebase
plugins.description: Rust MCP server that indexes Rust, Python, and TypeScript codebases into a LadybugDB property graph. Resolves imports and call chains, detects communities via Leiden algorithm, traces execution flows from entry points. 23 MCP tools: index_codebase, query_graph, get_symbol, impact_analysis, semantic_diff, and more. BM25+TF-IDF+RRF search. 220 tests.
plugins.runtime_notes: Requires Rust toolchain (cargo) for first-run compilation, or a pre-built binary at target/release/ai-architect-mcp.

plugins.name: reasoning
plugins.description: 97 genius reasoning patterns from history's greatest minds under one zetetic epistemic standard. Includes 19 team specialist agents, 61 skills across 7 categories, 25 commands across 9 categories, and 16 lifecycle hooks. PreToolUse/PostToolUse guards for git commit provenance, layer-check, and research citation.
plugins.runtime_notes: No external dependencies. postInstall script copies agents, skills, commands, and hooks to ~/.claude/.

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Stateless reducer that turns a feature description into a 9-file PRD. Multi-judge verification with weighted-average and Bayesian consensus scoring. Deterministic Hard Output Rules validation. Research-evidence-backed strategy selection with feedback loop into the EvidenceRepository. 17 MCP tools. 248 tests. Every constant sourced.
